Page 40 Cont.
June 3 Nicholas Renenopp 56 - cerebral hemorage two weeks ago, still unconscious.
8 Mrs. Helen Kelly - 45 - has husband an 3 children .... abdominal cancer - operation abandoned last Tuesday as hopeless .. . En- rolled ... Husband Enrolls PP. Souls.
Dolores Bargi - 15 - 17205 Riopelle - deaf since birth. Other faculties seem normal; They have been to all kind of doctors, only again and again to be disapointed; is inscribed To-day in S. Masses.
Page 41
June 11 Helen ....
11 Michael Wetowich - 25 - in Service for three yrs. Now in Ft. Eustis - nerve-break .... Enrolled ....
11 Mrs. Margaret Lynch - 43 - blood clott- arthritis. Mildred Merriman - 42 - threatening cancerous condition ...
Jun. 13 Thanks-Raymond Altherr - 8 - struck by Auto April 21 - concussion of brain - forty days unconscious - Dr's had no hope of recovery. Was enrolled April 28th-is here Today, quite improved.
W'm Green - 46 - mental-br'k-has wife and little daughter ....
Page 42 Blank Page
Page 43
Oct. 1 Henry Jos' Hagan - 57 - very threatening throat condition with tube in it ten days .... Operation To-morrow - enrolled in S. Mass As'n To-night at 7:20 $1. for poor Missions.
18 Mrs. Louise Dackerman - lutheran - 52 - fearfully enlarged spleen (cancerous) - Gave her blessing To-night with relic of Cross.
27 John S. Killeen - 57 - Enrolled Oct. 7 with Holy Souls for very threatening throat cancer. Today reported by sister as "not im- proved". She enrolles him again this time as a perpetual member. - also the Poor Souls specially. .. together 10.
